_about: Client multiplayer session settings. A guest whose link drops keeps the last room code and its peer token for window_seconds and tries to join the same room again every retry_seconds (at most max_tries times); a drop whose reason matches a no_rejoin_reasons entry (case-insensitive substring: the host left, the room closed, the runner was removed) never rejoins. Every player-facing line of the room panel, the host-left notice, the waiting-for-host overlay and the mod pack check is here (upper case); {code}, {seconds}, {names} are filled in by the game. wait_for_world_seconds is how long a guest waits for the host's first snapshot before the overlay offers LEAVE. refresh_min_seconds is the shortest gap between two REFRESH presses of the room list.
